# Image credits

## Current state: no photographs

The build environment for this demo had **no outbound network access to any
stock-photo host**. Unsplash, Pexels, Wikimedia Commons, Pixabay, Flickr,
Openverse and picsum.photos were each tried and each was refused at the egress
proxy (`403` to the CONNECT). Only `fonts.gstatic.com` and `github.com` were
reachable, which is why the fonts are real and the photographs are not.

Rather than ship grey placeholder rectangles, every image slot is filled with an
**original illustration generated by `tools/make_images.py`** — procedural SVG
rasterised to WebP and JPEG at the exact dimensions the markup declares, in the
site's own palette, drawn to the architecture of the region: coursed limestone,
Marseille tile roofs, triple-arched windows, terraced olive groves, cypress.

These illustrations are original work for this demo and carry no third-party
licence. They are **stand-ins, not the deliverable.** Replace them before this
site is shown as finished work: see “Swapping in real photography” in
`README.md`, and `tools/fetch-photos.sh`.

When sourcing, search for: *Lebanese mountain village*, *Douma Lebanon*,
*limestone house interior*, *triple arched window Lebanon*, *terracotta roof
Lebanon*, *olive terrace Mediterranean*, *mezze breakfast table*, *stone
staircase village*, *mountain valley dusk Lebanon*.

Reject anything that reads as Tuscany, Greece or Morocco. Lebanese village
architecture is pale limestone ashlar with red Marseille tile roofs and
triple-arched central windows — no whitewash, no blue shutters, no
horseshoe arches, no cypress-and-vineyard postcard.

## Fonts

| Family | Use | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cormorant Garamond 400 / 600 | Latin display | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | Google Fonts (`fonts/cormorant-*.woff2`, Latin subset) |
| Noto Naskh Arabic 400 | Arabic headings | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | Google Fonts (`fonts/naskh-400.woff2`, Arabic subset) |
| IBM Plex Sans Arabic 400 / 600 | Arabic text and UI | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | Google Fonts (`fonts/plexar-*.woff2`, Arabic subset) |
| System UI stack | Latin body text | — | the visitor's device |

The woff2 files are the unmodified subsets Google Fonts serves, self-hosted so
the site makes no third-party request. The OFL permits this.

## Icons

The WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook glyphs and the Dar Chams mark are drawn as
inline SVG paths in this repository. No icon font, no icon library.
